_meta.description: One plain sentence per role: HOW the work itself contributes to its SDG targets (targets are in roles.json). Written by the team; no statistics, so nothing here can be out of date.
_meta.themes_note: Themes group SDG targets into four things a user can say they care about. A target can belong to more than one theme.

roles.ai_ml_specialist: Builds the AI systems that raise productivity across industries (8.2) and strengthens Malaysia's own research and technology capability (9.5).
roles.renewable_energy_engineer: Every solar, wind or storage system you design adds clean power to the grid, directly raising the share of renewable energy (7.2).
roles.sustainability_specialist: Helps companies measure and cut their environmental impact and report it honestly (12.6), turning climate goals into company plans (13.2).
roles.big_data_specialist: Builds the data infrastructure that lets organisations make evidence-based decisions (8.2) and widens access to digital services (9.c).
roles.av_ev_specialist: Develops electric and autonomous vehicles that replace fuel-burning transport with cleaner technology (9.4).
roles.fintech_engineer: Builds digital payment and lending tools that bring banking to people and small businesses left out by traditional banks (8.10, 9.3).
roles.environmental_engineer: Designs water treatment and pollution control that keeps rivers clean and protects public health (6.3).
roles.bi_analyst: Turns raw data into decisions that make companies more productive (8.2) and supports their modernisation (9.2).
roles.cybersecurity_specialist: Keeps digital services safe and trusted, so more people can rely on them (9.c) and businesses keep running (8.2).
roles.digital_transformation_specialist: Helps traditional businesses adopt digital tools, raising productivity (8.2) and modernising industry (9.2).
roles.network_professional: Keeps internet connections reliable, which every digital service and remote job depends on (9.c).
roles.qa_engineer: Makes sure products are safe and built right the first time, reducing waste in manufacturing (8.2, 9.2).
roles.mech_technician: Keeps factory machines running safely and efficiently, protecting skilled, decent jobs in industry (8.5, 9.2).
roles.finance_manager: Steers money toward stable, sustainable growth (8.3) and supports access to financial services (8.10).
roles.agri_rnd_executive: Researches crops and farming methods that produce more food with less land and water (2.4).
roles.operations_manager: Runs processes that produce more with fewer resources and less waste (8.2).
roles.medical_specialist: Diagnoses and treats patients directly, bringing quality health care to the community (3.8).
roles.civil_engineer: Builds safe roads, bridges and public transport that cities and communities depend on (9.1, 11.2).
roles.supply_chain_specialist: Moves goods efficiently so less fuel, time and stock are wasted along the way (8.2).
roles.safety_engineer: Prevents injuries and makes workplaces safe for everyone who works there (8.8).
roles.data_entry_clerk: A role AI is shrinking fast; moving from here into data or AI work is itself the reskilling SDG 4.4 and 8.5 aim for.
roles.admin_assistant: A role AI is changing fast; growing into coordination or project work keeps it a decent, future-proof job (4.4, 8.5).
roles.bookkeeping_clerk: Routine bookkeeping is being automated; reskilling toward financial analysis keeps the career decent and secure (4.4, 8.5).
roles.bank_teller: Branch work is moving online; helping customers through that shift supports financial inclusion (8.10), and reskilling protects the job (4.4).
roles.postal_clerk: Mail is going digital; moving into logistics or digital services keeps the career secure (4.4, 8.5).
roles.software_developer: Builds the apps and services people and businesses use every day (9.c) and drives technological upgrading (8.2).
roles.data_analyst: Helps organisations decide with evidence instead of guesswork, which raises productivity (8.2).
roles.devops_engineer: Keeps digital and AI systems reliable in production (9.c), so research and products actually reach people (9.5).
roles.iot_specialist: Builds sensors and smart systems that cut energy use in industry (9.4) and monitor pollution in cities (11.6).
roles.electrical_engineer: Designs the power systems and smart grids that deliver reliable modern electricity (7.1) and connect clean energy to it (9.4).
roles.electrical_technician: Installs and maintains the electrical systems that keep power on (7.1), and does it safely (8.8).
roles.project_manager: A common growth path from admin and support work into a decent, future-proof role (8.5), leading teams that adopt new technology (8.2).
roles.product_manager: Turns local technology into products people use, supporting home-grown innovation (9.b) and productivity (8.2).
roles.customer_service_worker: A role AI chatbots are changing fast; the human part – solving hard problems with empathy – is what keeps it a decent job (8.5).
